plugins/cc_demo/rules/changelog-evidence:
## Changelog Evidence

When drafting a changelog entry, take every claim from the diff of the merged change, not from its title or its commit message.
plugins/cc_demo/rules/force-push-ban.md:
## Force-Push Ban

Never force-push to the default branch. A force-push once erased a day of merged work, so this holds even when the push looks harmless.
plugins/cc_demo/rules/rebase-policy.md:
## Rebase Policy

On a shared branch, prefer merge commits over rebases so that history other people have pulled stays stable.
plugins/cc_demo/rules/release-draft-grou:
## Release Draft Grounding

A draft for a release must cite the change it describes. An entry without a traceable merged change is removed before the draft is shared.
plugins/cc_demo/rules/release-language.m:
## Release Notes Language

Write release notes in plain English for end users: no internal ticket numbers, no jargon the reader cannot look up.
plugins/cc_demo/rules/release-sources-py:
---
description: Same wording as the always-loaded release rule, but only when Python files are touched.
paths:
  - '**/*.py'
---

## Release Notes Source

Before writing release notes, read the merged pull requests since the last tag and never rely on commit subjects alone.
